text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome back to the Dojo Invitational! Give it up for the boss! This was a brain-only update: a round-timer reset, a step-in throw plan, and a hook and roundhouse finisher, and the judge says every claim checks out. The body stayed put, so realism holds at 38, same as last time. Fix that neck seam, iron that rippled shirt, tame those boxy shorts and grow some real hair! In the charcoal rash guard and white hand wraps, the Landlord of the Ring, THE OWNER!
